rules.description: The portal must send a notification to the student when additional information is required for verification.
rules.condition: The Institute/School needs additional information for verification.
rules.outcome: The portal provides a facility to send an SMS or email to the concerned student.
rules.evidence_quote: If the Institute/School needs additional information for verification, the Portal will provide a facility to send SMS/Email to the concerned student.

rules.description: Only the Institute/School may modify an application at this stage, and any changes must be logged.
rules.condition: The process is at the stage where additional information has been requested.
rules.outcome: The Institute/School is allowed to make changes in select fields only, and a log of those changes is maintained on the portal.
rules.evidence_quote: Further, at this stage only Institute / School will be allowed to make changes in application (in select fields only) and a log of the same will be maintained on the Portal.

rules.description: The first‑level verifying authority must verify each application individually; bulk verification is not permitted.
rules.condition: Verification is being performed by the first level (Institute/School).
rules.outcome: Every application is verified individually and bulk verification is unavailable.
rules.evidence_quote: The Institute/School will verify every application individually and facility of bulk verification will not be available for the first level of Verifying Authority.

rules.description: The first‑level verification must confirm that students are genuine, eligible, and not duplicated in other scholarship schemes.
rules.condition: During first‑level verification of an application.
rules.outcome: The student’s genuineness, eligibility, and non‑duplication with Centre and State scholarship schemes are ensured.
rules.evidence_quote: The first level of verification will ensure that the students are genuine and eligible and rule out duplication with other scholarship schemes of Centre and State.

rules.description: The second‑level verification must validate the credentials of the school/institute and the hosteller claim.
rules.condition: During second‑level verification of an application.
rules.outcome: Credentials of the school/institute and the hosteller claim are verified.
rules.evidence_quote: The second level verification will ensure the credentials of school/Institute as well as the claim of hostellers.

rules.description: The State/UT/District (for NCT of Delhi and Uttar Pradesh) acts as the final verifying authority.
rules.condition: At the final stage of verification.
rules.outcome: The State/UT/District is the ultimate authority to approve or reject the application.
rules.evidence_quote: The State/UT/District (for NCT of Delhi and Uttar Pradesh) shall be the final verifying authority.

rules.description: An application verified by the first level is considered valid; otherwise it is invalid.
rules.condition: After the first level of verification has been performed.
rules.outcome: A duly verified application is treated as a Valid Application; an unverified one is treated as an Invalid Application.
rules.evidence_quote: An application duly verified by the first level of Verifying Authority (Institute/School) will be treated as Valid Application and counted for. An application which does not get verified by the first Verifying Authority will be treated as an Invalid Application.

rules.description: Valid applications are forwarded to PFMS to obtain a Beneficiary ID.
rules.condition: The application has been classified as valid.
rules.outcome: The application is simultaneously sent to PFMS for Beneficiary ID generation.
rules.evidence_quote: The valid applications will be simultaneously sent for obtaining Beneficiary id from PFMS.

rules.description: Only valid applications are shown to the second‑level verifying authority.
rules.condition: When displaying applications to the second level.
rules.outcome: The second‑level authority sees only applications that are valid.
rules.evidence_quote: Only valid applications will be displayed to the second level of Verifying Authority.

rules.description: The second‑level verifying authority is provided with a bulk verification facility.
rules.outcome: A facility for bulk verification is made available to the second‑level authority.
rules.evidence_quote: The second level of Verifying Authority will be provided with the facility of bulk verification.

rules.description: NSP may enable a mechanism for the second‑level authority (including State/UT even if not a verifying authority) to monitor first‑level verification progress.
rules.condition: When monitoring the progress of first‑level verification is required.
rules.outcome: A mechanism is provided to facilitate the second‑level authority for monitoring purposes.
rules.evidence_quote: However, NSP may provide a mechanism to facilitate the second level of verifying authority (to State/UT even if it is not a verifying authority) for monitoring the progress of verification by the first level of verifying authority.

rules.description: NSP must provide a real‑time monitoring mechanism that shows reasons for delays, rejection reports with reasons, and institute‑wise pendency reports.
rules.outcome: The mechanism indicates delay reasons, rejection reasons, and institute‑wise pendency.
rules.evidence_quote: NSP will provide a mechanism to monitor the verification process on real time basis. This mechanism will indicate reasons for delays, rejection report with reasons, and institute-wise pendency report.
